name: Big Daddy dune and Deadvlei
why: Up the crest of the highest dune around Sossusvlei, then a run down its face into the white clay pan of dead trees.
book: Park permit at the Sesriem gate office; gates open at sunrise and close at sunset (only guests inside the gate can be at the dunes for sunrise). The last 5 km from the 2x4 car park are deep sand: 4x4 or the park shuttle.
water: None: carry 2-3 litres each, more in summer.
dangers: Heat: by late morning the sand burns and there is no shade.
Soft sand makes the climb about twice as slow as it looks.
Wind on the crest: sand in the eyes, keep cameras covered.
turnaround: Not on the crest by 10:00: skip the summit and walk straight to Deadvlei.

points.name: Deadvlei 4x4 car park
points.note: The sand car park at the end of the 4x4 track. The path heads south over the low dunes.

points.name: Big Daddy crest
points.note: The top of the highest dune here, about 325 m over the pans: Sossusvlei, Deadvlei and dune crests to the horizon.

points.name: Deadvlei
points.note: Run down the steep face into the white clay pan of camel thorn trees, dead for about 600 years. Then 1 km back to the car park.
